about_the_game:
Eletar hero 2 is the sequel to the 2D platformer "Eletar Hero" and follows the events after the failure of Mr Steven's first plan. The Hero (Aaron Speed) is met with more like him who were chosen by the Eletar. They have chosen to work with or against Mr Stevens in his second and bigger plan to take over the world. Aaron and his new allies must find out and stop Mr Stevens plan, while having to fight new superpowered foes, and find the professor; so Aaron can finally find out why he was chosen and what these abilities mean for him.

Features

  • Three playable characters with different movement and abilities

  • Traverse around 11 different maze-like levels for each character

  • Fight Bosses with different abilities and fighting styles

  • Find hidden abilities the Eletar have left behind

  • Steam leaderboard

  • Ally support system

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit operating system
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8565U CPU @ 1.80GHz 1.99 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel(R) UHD Graphics 620 (128 MB)
  • Storage: 980 MB available space

short_description: Eletar Hero 2 is a 2D platformer where with your allies use the ability you have been given from the Eletar race to traverse through different maze-like levels, defeat many bosses and collect the other abilities the ancient Eletar left behind; all to stop a madman from taking over the world-again.
